name: Wheat
description: Wheat is a major cereal crop globally, grown primarily during the cooler Rabi season in India. It requires cool climate during early growth and warm, dry conditions during maturity.
careInstructions: Ensure timely irrigation, especially at the crown root initiation (CRI) stage (20-25 days after sowing). Apply nitrogenous fertilizers in split doses.

name: Rice (Paddy)
description: Rice is a staple crop needing high moisture, mostly grown in flooded fields during the Kharif monsoon season.
careInstructions: Maintain a standing water level of 2-5cm. Apply Zinc if soil is deficient.

name: Cotton
description: Cotton is an important cash crop known as 'White Gold'. It thrives in deep, moisture-retentive black soils.
careInstructions: Avoid waterlogging. Need regular scouting for pests. Weed management is critical in the first 60 days.

name: Maize (Corn)
description: Maize is a versatile crop used as food, feed, and industrial raw material. It responds well to fertilizers and assured irrigation.
careInstructions: Extremely sensitive to waterlogging. Ensure good drainage. Apply Nitrogen in splits.

name: Soybean
description: Soybean is a major oilseed crop. It requires well-drained soils and a warm, moist climate.
careInstructions: Inoculate seeds with Rhizobium before sowing. Requires good drainage.

name: Sugarcane
description: A long-duration cash crop requiring heavy irrigation and deep, well-drained soils.
careInstructions: Requires frequent irrigation during the tillering and grand growth phases. Earthing up is needed to prevent lodging.

name: Tomato
description: A popular vegetable crop grown almost year-round but sensitive to frost and extreme heat.
careInstructions: Stake tall varieties. Ensure regular, even watering to prevent blossom end rot.

name: Potato
description: A starchy tuber crop needing cool temperatures for tuberization and well-aerated soils.
careInstructions: Earth up 30-35 days after planting. Maintain moderate soil moisture.

name: Onion
description: Bulb crop needing mild weather for vegetative growth and dry heat for bulb maturity.
careInstructions: Keep the field weed-free. Stop irrigation 10-15 days before harvesting.

name: Groundnut (Peanut)
description: An important oilseed crop that prefers light, friable soils for easy peg penetration.
careInstructions: Apply gypsum at flowering stage. Do not disturb soil after pegging starts.

name: Chickpea (Gram)
description: A drought-tolerant pulse crop that grows well on residual soil moisture.
careInstructions: Avoid over-irrigation. Nipping of apical buds encourages branching.

name: Mustard
description: An oilseed crop mainly grown in North/Central India during winters.
careInstructions: Thinning is necessary 15-20 days after sowing. Sulfur application increases oil content.
